title: Polish the playoffs page for mobile

criteria.text: Bracket names fit: at 360 and 390 px wide the team names in the bracket boxes are no longer cut with an ellipsis, except at most the two longest fake names (before: 15 of 28 cut in the 8-team bracket). Match height does not grow. Before and after shots.
Bracket padding on phone is 8px 12px, so the first round starts near the left edge (before: 50px inside). Measured before and after.
Bracket text meets 4.5:1 in dark and light themes: loser rows, winner green, and the Winner-of hint and seed grey. Contrast measured before and after.
The match label chip (for example WB 1.1) no longer overlaps the first row text. Measured on all matches of the 8-team bracket, phone and desktop.
Light theme: the division title and View buttons on the bracket list meet 4.5:1 (before: 3.74, 3.16, 3.80, 4.49). Dark theme looks the same.
Season picker on phone is at least 44px tall, shows the Current label at 360 px, and its dropdown rows are at least 44px tall. Measured.
The bracket card header wraps cleanly and the status badge is not clipped at 320 px. Before and after shots at 320, 360 and 390.
The loading spinners are visible in the dark theme (at least 3:1) and the page loading view is announced as a status.
After tapping View Live Bracket, a loading view shows at once instead of the division list, and the screen starts at the top of the bracket. Covered by a new test and a slow-network shot.

On phone the Live updates pill no longer covers bracket rows, buttons or footer text (it shrinks to a dot with an accessible name). Unchanged from 768px up. DEFAULT chosen without asking: Doug can veto.
Final standings rows line up: the logo column is the same for places 1 to 3 and for place 4 and below. Measured.

No new console errors; the page does not scroll sideways at 390, 360 and 320; desktop 1280 looks the same except the label-chip fix; existing tests pass; all required checks pass; the left-alone list is reported (back-to-list button, bracket spinner position, BYE text, duplicate stage title).
